🎥🎬: Moon Knight (2022)

Steven Grant, a quiet museum gift shop employee, begins experiencing blackouts and terrifying visions before discovering he shares his body with mercenary Marc Spector. Chosen as the avatar of the Egyptian moon god Khonshu, the two must work together to stop a dangerous cult from unleashing the goddess Ammit.

As Steven and Marc struggle with their fractured identities, they uncover ancient secrets, battle supernatural enemies, and learn to embrace their shared destiny. Blending psychological mystery with superhero action, Moon Knight explores the fight between light and darkness—both in the world and within the mind.

#MoonKnight #Marvel #MCU #OscarIsaac #SuperheroSeries

source_details.title: Moon Knight
source_details.synopsis: Moon Knight is an American television miniseries created by Jeremy Slater for the streaming service Disney+, based on Marvel Comics featuring the character of the same name. It is the sixth television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) to be produced by Marvel Studios, sharing continuity with the films of the franchise. It follows Marc Spector and Steven Grant, two alters of a man with dissociative identity disorder (DID), as they are drawn into a mystery involving Egyptian gods. Slater serves as head writer with Mohamed Diab leading the directing team. Oscar Isaac stars as Marc Spector / Moon Knight and Steven Grant / Mr. Knight, with May Calamawy, Karim El Hakim, F. Murray Abrah
